title: Simple Lootbox
description: A simple lootbox item for modpack creators.
body:
This mod adds a simple lootbox item, and a crafting item for it, into your world.

A Lootbox can be made with 8 Gilt Powder surrounding a chest in a crafting table.  Gilt Powder is crafted with 3 gold nuggets and a blaze powder.

When used, the lootbox has a chance of giving the player a random reward from its loot table; by default this is 4 emeralds, 12 gold ingots, 8 blaze rods, or 1 diamond.

This mod was intentionally created to be customized by modpack developers to fit whatever use they may need, hence the lackluster default rewards and obtainment.

If any bugs occur, you can reach me at @cephelo on discord.
